-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.ApiCtx` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem errProposalDropped_persistent (err : GoInterface) : Persistent (errProposalDropped err)

def errProposalDropped (err : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrProposalDropped) err DFrac.discard ∗ ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝)

theorem errStopped_persistent (err : GoInterface) : Persistent (errStopped err)

theorem propErr_persistent (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err : GoInterface) : Persistent
    (propErr cd err)

def errStopped (err : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrStopped) err DFrac.discard ∗ ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝)

theorem doneNilCtx_persistent (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) : Persistent (doneNilCtx ctx)

theorem ctxErrVal_persistent (err : GoInterface) : Persistent (ctxErrVal err)

theorem ctxErr_persistent (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err : GoInterface) : Persistent
    (ctxErr cd err)

def ctxErrVal (err : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜context.isTypedErr err⌝ ∗
      (typedPointsto (globalAddr context.Canceled) err DFrac.discard ∨
        typedPointsto (globalAddr context.DeadlineExceeded) err DFrac.discard))

def ctxErr (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ □ cd.PDone ∗ context.ContextClosed cd.Done_gn ∗ ctxErrVal err)

def doneNilCtx (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          True -∗
            ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal chan.nil)) -∗
              WP ((intoVal (methods ctx.ty go!"Done" ctx.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

theorem nodeCtx_persistent (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : Persistent
    (nodeCtx ctx cd)

def bgCd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF) :=
  { Values := GMap.empty, Deadline := none, Done_gn := { doneGn := 0, closedGn := 0 }, PDone := iprop(False) }

def propErr (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(nodeErr cd err ∨ stepErr err)

def stepErr (err : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨ errProposalDropped err)

def nodeCtx (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(doneNilCtx ctx ∨ context.isContext ctx cd)

theorem stepErr_persistent (err : GoInterface) : Persistent (stepErr err)

theorem nodeErr_persistent (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err : GoInterface) : Persistent
    (nodeErr cd err)

def nodeErr (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨ errStopped err ∨ ctxErr cd err)
